title: docs(ui-merge): fold objectui.org into objectstack docs, K4 — retire the site, host 301s, links
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyMpJZ67jrDrno4jY1

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoF6updQcwW9xVUmevhhFabA)_

Fixes #27145
Part of #26993

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:删除 `ui/apps/site`(objectui.org 站点)、`ui/content/docs`(201 页)和 `deploy-ui-site` 部署任务;在 `apps/docs/redirects.mjs` 加 184 条只对 objectui.org 主机生效的永久跳转(183 页逐条 + 1 条兜底);37 个 ui package.json 的 homepage、README 链接、console 插件 homepage 改指 objectstack.ai/docs;33 处包描述 "Object UI" 改为 "ObjectUI";读旧文档页的测试和门禁改读 `content/docs/frontend`。
- 为什么改:K1–K3 已把 objectui.org 的内容并入本站,旧站和旧页继续留着就是两份会漂移的文档。
- 风险与回滚:跳转在 objectui.org 域名指向本项目前不生效(#27030),不会影响本站现有 URL;删掉的只有站点、旧页和只为它们存在的测试。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`apps/docs/redirects.mjs` 的 `objectuiRedirects` 表;下方 "Tests whose page is gone" 一节(哪些测试删了、哪些只删了读页面的那一半);越界声明一节。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:docs-redirects`;`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`;`git grep -n "ui/apps/site\|ui/content/docs" -- ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'` 为空。
- 需要你做的:确认下方两处越界(`content/docs/frontend` 补回 75 条 doc-snippet 标记、一处 `destructive` → `danger`),以及 filter-builder 的类型表在文档删除后改为测试内冻结列表;合并由你来做,合并后按 #27030 迁移域名。

## What changes

**Redirects.** `apps/docs/redirects.mjs` gains `objectuiRedirects`: one row per published path of the old site (the 183 pages under its `content/docs` at the fold, by URL, taken from the final K1 #27168, K2 #27170 and K3 #27179 mapping tables), plus a final catch-all to `/docs/frontend` for the home page, playground, `llms.txt` and OG images. The rows are host-scoped (`has: [{ type: 'host', value: '(?:www\.)?objectui\.org' }]`) and permanent, so they cannot shadow a URL of this site and stay inert until the domains move (#27030). `scripts/check-docs-redirects.mjs` now judges them on the host the destination is served from: every destination is a real page and none is a `docsRedirects` source. No row targets the retired `/docs/ui/{console,studio,setup-app}` pages.

**Deletions.** `ui/apps/site` (43 files), `ui/content/docs` (201 files), the `deploy-ui-site` job in `docs-deploy.yml` and its CI wiring, the site-only gates `check-doc-example-ids` and `check-docs-route-eager-closure` with their tests, the three `site-*` script tests, and `ui/e2e/docs-smoke.spec.ts` / `ui/e2e/cascading-options.spec.ts`, which drove the site. `rfcs/0001-clipboard-paste.md` moves to `ui/docs/rfcs/` and `guide/console-architecture.md` to `ui/docs/design/`. The lockfile drops the site importer.

**Links.** The `homepage` field of 37 `package.json` files under `ui/`, the `homepage` in `ui/apps/console/plugin.ts`, the README and skill links that pointed at objectui.org or at `ui/content/docs`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`'s UI documentation paragraph, and the root `README.md`. Each URL goes to the page that carries its content now (the redirect table), keeping a fragment only where the target page has that heading. The Console package's homepage is `/docs/build-without-code`, its plugin manifest's is `/docs/frontend`. The changeset covers the 35 published `@object-ui/*` packages whose metadata changed and `@objectstack/skills`.

**Spelling.** 33 package `description` fields say "ObjectUI" instead of "Object UI".

**Readers re-pointed.** The ui doc gates and their tests read `content/docs/frontend` (root = `ui/`, so labels read `../content/docs/frontend/…`); floors were re-measured on 34 pages (76 files with the READMEs). `check-doc-links` now judges the 61 `objectstack.ai/docs` URLs against `apps/docs` instead of trusting them. `markdown-test-inputs` resolves the monorepo docs tree too, and its ledger is re-keyed. The ui CI filter also covers `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`, which two Test UI pins now read.

### Tests whose page is gone

K1 kept 34 pages of the 183 as files; the renderer pages became one table (`frontend/renderers.mdx`) with no interface fences, and several guides were dropped or moved into platform pages. A test that pinned such a page was re-pointed when its content still exists, and otherwise lost only the leg that read the page:

- Re-pointed to the page's new home: most of them (e.g. the three `guideCrudAppRenders` tests, the layout and app-shell guide pins, `page-body-arity-8310`, `readme-kanban-example-8256`). Two follow content that K2 moved: `objectname-binding-required-11605` reads the block table in `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`, and `element-data-source-objectname-waiver-11117` reads its `element:number` fence there.
- Deleted whole (their only subject was a page that no longer exists): `slotted-pages-header-example-11165`, `button-group-doc-surface-6347`, `component-docs-disabled-inherited-7239`, `component-docs-retired-handler-keys-7340`, `chart-type-doc-row-11521`, `schema-reference-named-list-view-keys-7923`, `public-block-doc-examples-bag-11321`, `calendar-doc-key-set-8830`.
- Page legs removed, declaration/mirror/renderer legs kept: `overlay-node-slot-doc-types-7082`, `overlay-trigger-union-7081`, `alert-dialog-read-dialect-7104`, `div-guidance-names-box` (three surfaces now), `object-kanban-group-by-limit-7322`, `catalog-gallery-render` and `plugin-dashboard-gallery-render` (the docs-site host parity cases), `page-actions-refusal-7926` (one control whose example moved to `/docs/ui/pages`), and the named-subject list in `object-calendar-record-source-7313`.
- ⚠️ `filter-builder-mirror-6939`: decision batch #88 made the published doc the authority for `FilterField.type`, and the doc is gone. The doc's last 14-member union is now a frozen `LAST_PUBLISHED_TYPES` list in the test, and the set-equality pin still holds the mirror to it in both directions. That brings back the hand-kept list objectui#8774 removed, for want of a source; the doc reader and its objectui#9073 fixtures went with the page.

Every retired leg carries a short `objectstack#27145` note at its site.

### Bounded fixes outside the claim

The claim (comment 6471445866) allows no edits to `content/docs/**` page bodies beyond link fixes. Two edits under `content/docs/frontend` go past that, both needed to keep the gates this PR moves onto those pages green:

- 75 `{/* doc-snippet: fragment — … */}` markers restored above fences in 17 pages. They stood on the same fences in the old pages; K1 dropped them, so `check:doc-snippets` reported every fragment as a compile failure once it read `content/docs/frontend`. The marker text is the old page's, unchanged.
- One `"variant": "destructive"` → `"variant": "danger"` in `frontend/layout.mdx`, the value `action:button` declares; the doc-types gate refused the old spelling.

No other page body changed. The seat should amend the claim if it accepts these.

## Acceptance notes

`git grep -n "ui/apps/site\|ui/content/docs" -- ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'` prints nothing.

`git grep -n "objectui.org" -- ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'` prints 66 lines, all history comments, fixtures or the redirect machinery:

- Redirect machinery: `apps/docs/redirects.mjs` (5), `apps/docs/lib/site.ts` (1), `scripts/check-docs-redirects.mjs` (1).
- CORS wildcard fixtures that use the host as sample data: `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/pattern-matcher.test.ts` (19), `hono-plugin.test.ts` (3) and its `README.md` (3), `packages/adapters/hono/src/hono.test.ts` (4).
- Host-matching fixtures: `ui/packages/cli/src/__tests__/check-schema-marker.test.ts` (2), `check-jsonc-parse.test.ts` (1); the ruling note in `ui/packages/cli/src/commands/check.ts` (1).
- `check-doc-links`: the gate's history sections and its objectstack#27145 note (`ui/scripts/check-doc-links.mjs`, 10) and two test-header lines (`ui/scripts/__tests__/check-doc-links.test.ts`, 2).
- History comments: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (3), `.github/workflows/docs-deploy.yml` (2), `ui/e2e/live/cascading-options.spec.ts`, `ui/packages/layout/src/__tests__/app-shell-docs-nav-example.test.ts`, `ui/scripts/__tests__/zero-test-member-exclusion-9106.test.ts`, `ui/scripts/check-doc-fence-languages.mjs`, `ui/scripts/check-doc-json-fences.mjs` (1 each).
- The changeset (2) and the root `CHANGELOG.md` (2, history).

## Tests

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 171 files, 4915 passed, 2 skipped.
- The 92 package, app and example test files that read docs pages: all pass.
- Type-checks: `packages/types` (`tsconfig.test.json`), `examples/schema-catalog` (`tsconfig.test.json`), `apps/console`, and the seven packages whose tests changed.

## Verification

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 150 commands for this diff after merging `main` at 38bbc2f2 (re-merged at 76740286: clean, the ledger audit and the new tests it brought pass). All 150 ran locally:

- 143 exited 0 on the first pass.
- Fixed and re-run green: `check-skills-token-ratchet` (two skill links paid by deleting text in the same file), `vitest run scripts/` (the expression-carriage fence floor after the merge; `check-vi-mock-inherit` had timed out under the sweep's load and passes alone), `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (needed the pinned sha fetched).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:docs` and `check:skill-examples` refused at first for want of a built `@objectstack/spec`; after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` both exit 0 (232 generated files in sync; 270 prose examples type-check).
- Not measured locally, prerequisite only: `check:dts-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` read every package's `dist`, which this checkout has not built. This diff changes no build inputs; CI runs both.

Known red on `main` too: the census non-firing control (layout `page.tsx:462`) fails on `origin/main` as well, so it is not this PR's.

Tier H, over 3000 changed lines: draft until green, Tesla merges.

**Re-merge 2026-10-29 (head 6a7c7794).** `main` brought #27275, which deleted `ui/packages/vscode-extension`; the modify/delete conflicts resolved to the deletion on both sides (the extension's `export-to-react-compiles` leg and its ledger row go with the package). That package held the tree's last two self-repo GitHub URLs, so `check-doc-links.test.ts`'s sweep now finds none and its population floor is gone; the `selfRepoPath` unit test still feeds the extractor every URL shape. Re-run after the merge: `vitest run scripts/` (one red, the floor above, then green), the 36 changed package tests, `markdown-test-inputs --audit`, `check-docs-redirects`, `check:doc-types` / `doc-snippets` / `doc-examples` / `doc-json` / `readme-exports` / `skill-examples`, `docs:check-links`, the ui CLI `check`, spec `check:liveness`, `lint:root`, the ui package lint and root `pnpm lint`: all exit 0.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (`packages/spec` is not touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (exit 0 after merging `main` at 76740286).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched, nothing to regenerate.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 summary excepted, per the dispatch convention).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
